items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Well, we lived right around the corner from each other for a long time.

ctx.x: Earl Palmer has second-generation drums. Your son has Earl Palmer's drums, and I think Laura Bryant said her son was going to get a set of Earl Palmer's drums.
Well, we lived right around the corner from each other for a long time.
Yes, I remember. Not in Baldwin Hills...
